account_block_urgency.label: suspicious
account_block_urgency.rationale: Threatens imminent blocking and demands immediate action or card details.

bill_reminder.label: legitimate
bill_reminder.rationale: Due-date reminder that points to the official app or counter, no link or individual.

delivery_update.label: legitimate
delivery_update.rationale: Delivery status with no payment or credential request.

everyday_money_talk.label: legitimate
everyday_money_talk.rationale: Ordinary conversation between acquaintances that mentions money.

fake_payment_claim.label: suspicious
fake_payment_claim.rationale: Claims a payment was made and asks for money or approval in return.

fee_or_prize_demand.label: suspicious
fee_or_prize_demand.rationale: Demands an upfront fee for a prize/job, or threatens disconnection unless paid to an individual.

impersonation_money.label: suspicious
impersonation_money.rationale: Impersonates family, an employer or an authority to request money or secrecy.

kyc_link.label: suspicious
kyc_link.rationale: Pressures the recipient to 'update' identity details through a link.

otp_delivery.label: legitimate
otp_delivery.rationale: Delivers a code to the account holder and warns not to share it; asks for nothing.

otp_request.label: suspicious
otp_request.rationale: Asks the recipient to disclose a one-time code.

security_advisory.label: legitimate
security_advisory.rationale: Hard negative: mentions OTPs, blocking or fraud, but only to warn or confirm a user action.

transaction_alert.label: legitimate
transaction_alert.rationale: Informational debit/credit notification with no request.

unclear_account_notice.label: ambiguous
unclear_account_notice.rationale: An account notice that could be genuine or a lure; it asks for no credential.

unverified_payment_request.label: ambiguous
unverified_payment_request.rationale: A plausible payment request whose legitimacy cannot be judged from the text alone.

amount_format_only.label: consistent
amount_format_only.rationale: Expected amount written without grouping/decimals (1234.5 vs 1,234.50); same value.

amount_mismatch.label: discrepancy
amount_mismatch.rationale: Expected amount differs from the rendered amount.

consistent.label: consistent
consistent.rationale: All four supplied expectations equal the rendered values.

currency_mismatch.label: discrepancy
currency_mismatch.rationale: Expected currency differs from the rendered currency.

missing_recipient.label: insufficient_evidence
missing_recipient.rationale: Recipient line not rendered but an expected recipient is supplied; it cannot be compared.

no_expected_values.label: consistent
no_expected_values.rationale: No expectations supplied; the screenshot itself is unremarkable.

placeholder_recipient.label: discrepancy
placeholder_recipient.rationale: Rendered recipient is a template placeholder such as 'Merchant Name'.

recipient_mismatch.label: discrepancy
recipient_mismatch.rationale: Expected recipient differs from the rendered recipient.

reference_format_only.label: consistent
reference_format_only.rationale: Expected reference differs only in separators/case.

reference_mismatch.label: discrepancy
reference_mismatch.rationale: Expected reference differs from the rendered one by two digits.

unreadable.label: insufficient_evidence
unreadable.rationale: Blank or random-noise image; nothing can be read.

not_generated.webpage: SatyaLens webpage/phishing-page detection is not implemented
